notVendored: test/ (contains remote-specific tests; persona/rewind acceptance is in setup/test_persona_rewind_sdk.mjs)

patches.why: Upstream early forceSystemPrompt freezes the prompt before later extensions add SEEP, boundaries and project context.
patches.what: Both modes assemble raw personality sections through before_agent_start. Cached preserves SDK transcript deltas. Every-turn uses the host pi-ai getCurrentSystemMessage at each provider call to replay the full current prompt and tools into a leading system checkpoint. No forceSystemPrompt and no conversation-text scrubbing.

patches.why: Regex scrubbing removes literal user, assistant and tool material; rewriting only the first system message can be overridden by later deltas.
patches.what: Remove the scrubbing helpers. Repair only named system sections at the last system delta when the effective value differs. Raw options and rendered transcript sections are kept distinct.

patches.why: The workbench load-system-prompt owns generic-rules and applies project priority.
patches.what: Persona never writes or deletes generic-rules.

patches.why: Explicit off must suppress legacy PERSONALITY.md; a usable directory default must win in either load order. Rewind must keep the latest conversation choice.
patches.what: Share explicit/default/legacy selection resolution with load-system-prompt. Read all append-only session entries. Correct comments that claimed rewind restored earlier choices.

patches.why: Upstream swallowed write failures and returned unsaved effective values; malformed JSON could be overwritten.
patches.what: Merge unknown keys, reject malformed existing settings, write an exclusive temporary file and rename atomically, clean temporary files, and propagate errors. Persona commands notify success only after saving; cancellations change nothing.

patches.why: Only-if-absent legacy mounting freezes old content; context sections are already rendered and later system deltas can override a first-message repair.
patches.what: Use shared directory selection precedence. Refresh assets and reconcile owned rendered sections at each request, including updates and removal. Keep RULES project .pi > project > user priority, SEEP and boundary sections.

patches.why: Every-turn uses the installed SDK transcript replay helper instead of duplicating the prompt or tool replay algorithm.
patches.what: Declare host-provided @earendil-works/pi-ai as a peer dependency; no bundled runtime or remote extension.

patches.why: Rewinding a plain earlier turn also removes later turns whose tool side effects remain on disk.
patches.what: Carry later tool-work flags backwards across rewind candidates, requiring confirmation for every discarded tool turn. Final plain reply undo and raw draft text stay unchanged.
